name: Nodebench
description: Operating intelligence for founders. 350 MCP tools across 57 domains — decision intelligence, entity research, QA automation, and session memory that compounds across sessions. Starts with 15 tools via progressive discovery, expands to 350 as agents discover what they need. Includes weekly resets, company analysis, competitor briefs, delegation packets, site crawling, diff comparison, and test generation. Ships with auto-QA rules, analyst diagnostic methodology, and agentic reliability checklist.
longDescription:
Ships **2 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Commands** (2): `agentic-reliability-audit`, `nodebench-qa`
- **MCP servers** (1): `nodebench`

Installs with `claude plugin install nodebench@claude-community` from `HomenShum/nodebench-ai` (`packages/mcp-local/claude-plugin`).

NodeBench MCP inside Claude Code. Start with the same 9-tool workflow lane the main package exposes, then load deeper toolsets only when the task actually needs them.
